column1: # REGISTER — mutation-proofs.partial-integrity.tsv
# Wave: partial-integrity repair of the three guards named in registers/guard-domains.tsv as
# substring-keyed, heading-keyed or per-token-exposed:
#   tests/test_skill_integrity.py, tests/test_audit_drift.py, tests/test_cited_paths_exist.py
# WHAT A ROW IS. One row per assertion added or repaired. Every row records a MUTATION applied to
# the SUBJECT (a document, SKILL.md, the tree) — never to the test — plus the failure actually
# observed, and a DECOY of similar shape that the guard must not fire on. Green is not evidence;
# the observed column is.
# VERDICTS
#   PROVEN   the mutation was applied, the named test went red with the quoted first line, the
#            decoy was applied and the suite stayed green, and both were reverted (git diff clean).
#   PIN      a matcher pin: the assertion runs against fixture strings it writes itself, so NO
#            subject mutation can reach it, by design. This is disclosed rather than dressed up as
#            a proof — see the note in each such row. It is not DECORATIVE: it fires on a narrowing
#            of the recogniser, which is the failure mode it exists for, and both files already
#            carry this idiom for the same stated reason.
#   PRE-RED  the assertion is red at this HEAD on the live corpus without any mutation, because it
#            found a real drift. The drift, not a mutation, is the evidence. See REPORTED DRIFT.
# REGISTER-PREMISE CORRECTIONS made in this wave (evidence in the report):
#   * test_skill_integrity.py no longer contains the f"def {node}(" substring symbol check at all —
#     it was RETIRED at 028e900 in favour of the AST check in test_cited_paths_exist.py
#     (_module_level_names). guard-domains.tsv's keyed_on cell for that file is stale on that half.
#   * test_audit_drift.py's em-dash heading is NOT a silent-vacuity risk: _simaudit_rows() calls
#     SIMAUDIT_RAW.index(heading), which RAISES. Measured: rewriting the em dash to a hyphen gives
#     26 failed, 68 passed — loud, not quiet. Fixed at 690fba1.
#   * The "530 -> 9999" defect is in VALIDATION.md line 31, not NODE-PARITY-AUDIT.md; the mechanism
#     described is exactly right. Measured pre-repair: 94 passed.
#   * test_cited_paths_exist.py ALREADY collects bare-prose paths (the BARE token family added at
#     028e900). Measured: _recognise("see references/03-flow-routing.md for it") returns that path.
#     guard-domains.tsv's keyed_on cell for that file is stale.
